description: This file defines the BufferResult class, a container for the result of request-response interactions that contain Buffer payloads. It extends RequestResponseResult and provides static factory methods to create instances with various combinations of status codes, payloads, content types, and application properties. The class also exposes a method to retrieve the content type.

classes.name: BufferResult
classes.description: A container for the opaque result of a request-response service invocation, holding status, payload, content type, and application properties.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory methods to create BufferResult instances with various parameters.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the media type describing the payload.
